name: Hephaestus
description: A zone-control support who deploys 3 mechanical devices at battle start, activating them one per Ultimate cast to build toward a field-wide Fusion effect. Anchored to his Forge, he gains unlimited range and damage reduction in exchange for total immobility.

skills.name: Mech Domain
skills.description: Summons 3 inactive mechanical devices at combat start. When cast, activates the furthest device. Allies within its AoE restore 15 Energy and HP equal to 50% ATK per sec. Enemies in the AoE gain -15% ATK and -20% ATK SPD. If all devices are activated, decreases DMG dealt by enemies by 20%, and grants all allies 30% DMG bonus and 50% ATK SPD for 5s. This effect also triggers on Hephaestus's subsequent Ultimates.

upgrades.level2: Allies in the activated device's AoE restore 20 Energy and HP equal to 60% ATK per sec.
upgrades.level3: Enemies in the activated device's AoE gain -20% ATK and -30% ATK SPD.
upgrades.level4: If all devices are activated, decreases DMG dealt by enemies by 40%, and grants all allies 50% DMG bonus and 80% ATK SPD.

skills.name: Artisan's Insight
skills.description: Hephaestus fires a beam to restrain the enemy with the highest DPS for 2s (+0.5s for each activated device on the field), reducing the target's Armor and M-RES by 20%.

upgrades.level3: Duration extends by 1s for each activated device on the field.

upgrades.level4: Hephaestus gains 200 initial Energy on entry.

skills.name: Molten Aegis
skills.description: Heals the weakest ally for HP equal to 150% ATK and reduces their incoming DMG by 10% for 5s. For each activated device on the field, further reduces incoming DMG by 5%.

upgrades.level3: For each activated device on the field, further reduces incoming DMG by 7.5%.
upgrades.level4: Healing is increased to HP equal to 200% of ATK.

relic.name: Undying Forge
relic.description: At combat start, Hephaestus places a forging bench before him. When he moves away, it teleports him back and inflicts Overload, disabling him for 5s. Hephaestus enters the [Dedicated] state near the bench, gaining infinite attack range and 30% DMG RED.

upgrades.level2: In the [Dedicated] state, the CD of Artisan's Insight and Molten Aegis -50%.
upgrades.level3: In the [Dedicated] state, Hephaestus's max Energy -30%.
upgrades.level4: In the [Dedicated] state, Hephaestus takes 60% less DMG.
